integrity: The published 2013 minimum-length result and classical Eulerian counting theorems are credited as prior work. A full finite calculation and separate direct census support the new numerical classification; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the four-letter DNA alphabet, circular words, and dinucleotide windows. It is not an all-k enumeration or a theorem about linear probes; possible unindexed historical priority remains unresolved.
title: Exact enumeration of shortest reverse-complement dinucleotide covering cycles
